messages:
alex: Observed a spike of intermittent 502s on /api/generate in eu-west1 since ~23:50 UTC. Small parsing edge-case in headers suspected. I pushed a one-line guard (sha: a1b2c3d). Can we fast-track a hotfix in tonight's 00:30-01:00 UTC window?

deploybot: Deploy request received for redwood/api:hotfix-a1b2c3d. Canary: 10% for 5m -> 100% if healthy. Respond with +1 to approve.

mira (eng-oncall): +1. Ran quick staging smoke against the artifact; response OK. Sample: `curl -s https://staging.api/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq .status` -> 200.

dan (sre): +1. Prep rollback commands below. I'll watch ingress and LB errors during rollout.

Rollback options:
1) image revert:
`kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:main -n prod-eu && kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n prod-eu`
2) rollout undo:
`kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n prod-eu --to-revision=87`

lee (qa): Staging smoke looks clean. I'll monitor 5xx, p95, and encoder warnings during canary. Draft release note: https://docs.internal/release/notes/a1b2c3d-draft

deploybot: Scheduled deploy at 00:31 UTC. Canary started 00:33 UTC at 10% traffic. Metrics: https://console.redwood/metrics/prod-eu?job=canary

alex: Canary healthy at +3m. No 5xx increase, latencies stable.

mira: Promote at +6m if still clean. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Promoting to 100% traffic at 00:40 UTC... promotion complete.

dan: Watching dashboards; all green. No pod restarts.

lee: Final smoke passed. Published release note: "Hotfix a1b2c3d: normalize header parsing to prevent intermittent 502s in EU region."

mira: Closing window. If any regressions, use rollback commands above and ping #eng-oncall. Thanks team.
